$$\int_\Omega |\nabla u|^2\,dx = -\int_\Omega u\,\Delta u\,dx + \int_{\partial\Omega} u\,\frac{\partial u}{\partial n}\,dS = -\int_\Omega u\,\Delta u\,dx.$$

By the standard Poincaré inequality (applicable since $u \in W^{1,2}_0(\Omega)$):

$$\|u\|_{0,\Omega} \leq C_p\,\|\nabla u\|_{0,\Omega}. \quad (\star\star)$$
